scrape_overhead_ms.note: each scrape takes one pooled PostgreSQL connection and runs one SQL snapshot statement outside the instrumented spans, so before/after scrapes perturb the case slightly

phase_limits: Exact SQL lock wait is still unmeasured: state_row and authority_lock are client round trips and include statement submission, PostgreSQL execution and row return.
Values are per process. Counters reset across h.stop/h.start and are never differenced across processes; a case spanning a restart reports process_restarted instead of a delta.
Phase spans nest (native_git_hydration contains remote GET and decrypt) and must not be summed.
Bytes are logical payload of successful S3-backed transfers only; local-filesystem object storage emits no remote_* series, and retries, headers and TLS overhead are excluded.
